simple.meaning: אֶלְתּוֹלַד (ʼEltôwlad) is a Hebrew word meaning “Eltolad , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֶלְתּוֹלַד (H513) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 15:30, with occurrences in Joshua.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶלְתּוֹלַד (H513) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֶלְתּוֹלַד (H513) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֶלְתּוֹלַד (ʼEltôwlad) / H513 is traced through Joshua 15:30, Joshua 19:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H513. Eltolad אֶלְתּוֺלַד proper name, of a location (compare תּוֺלַד below ילד ) city in southern Judah Josh 15:30 ; 19:4 ; compare also תּוֺלָ֑ד (q. v.) 1Chr 4:29 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from 410 and a masculine form of 8435 (compare 8434 ); God (is) generator;
